map.输入工件材料、厚度、缺陷类型与检测要求，自动推荐适合的无损检测方法（UT超声波/: Enter workpiece material, thickness, defect type and inspection requirements, and the tool automatically recommends a suitable nondestructive method (UT ultrasonic / RT radiography / MT magnetic particle / PT penetrant / ET eddy current) with a comparative analysis.
map.对比不同探伤设备灵敏度与检出概率。: Compare the sensitivity and detection probability of different flaw-detection devices.
map.按缺陷尺寸阈值选型。: Select the method by defect size threshold.
map.：设备 A 可检出 ≥0.5mm 缺陷、设备 B ≥1.0mm：A 相对 B 灵: : device A detects defects ≥0.5mm and device B ≥1.0mm, so A is 100% more sensitive than B (threshold halved) and is more reliable for micro-cracks.
map.：信号 80dB、噪声 60dB：信噪比 = 80−60 = 20dB，≥12d: : signal 80dB, noise 60dB: signal-to-noise ratio = 80−60 = 20dB; ≥12dB generally identifies defects reliably, below that misses are likely.
map.高灵敏度易检出微缺陷但误报增多、成本上升；按验收标准选合适阈值，兼顾检出率与效率: High sensitivity detects micro defects but raises false positives and cost; pick the threshold from the acceptance standard, balancing detection rate and efficiency.
map.信噪比怎么影响探伤？: How does signal-to-noise ratio affect flaw detection?
map.信噪比低时缺陷信号淹没在噪声中，需提高增益或滤波；过高增益会引入杂波，需平衡。: When the signal-to-noise ratio is low the defect signal drowns in noise and gain or filtering must be increased; too much gain introduces clutter, so balance is needed.
